mapper.select: SELECT sc.id, sc.dish_id, d.category_id, d.name AS dish_name, d.image_url AS dish_image, d.price, sc.quantity, ROUND(d.price * sc.quantity, 2) AS amount, d.status FROM shopping_cart sc JOIN dish d ON d.id = sc.dish_id WHERE sc.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY sc.create_time DESC, sc.id DESC

SELECT sc.id, sc.dish_id, d.category_id, d.name AS dish_name, d.image_url AS dish_image, d.price, sc.quantity, ROUND(d.price * sc.quantity, 2) AS amount, d.status FROM shopping_cart sc JOIN dish d ON d.id = sc.dish_id WHERE sc.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY sc.create_time DESC, sc.id DESC FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, user_id, dish_id, quantity, create_time, update_time FROM shopping_cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND dish_id = #{dishId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopping_cart (user_id, dish_id, quantity) VALUES (#{userId}, #{dishId}, #{quantity})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM shopping_cart WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
